description: This bar chart, titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks,” visually compares the performance of two models—“Llama-3-8B-it” (represented by dark blue bars) and “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” (represented by brown bars)—across nine different academic and practical evaluation benchmarks listed along the horizontal axis as “Dataset and Metrics.” The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 10, indicating the percentage score achieved by each model on each benchmark. The chart displays two bars per benchmark, with the dark blue bar representing the Llama-3-8B-it model and the brown bar representing the “Ours” model. For each benchmark, the height of the bar corresponds to the score percentage. The benchmarks are presented in the following order from left to right: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The scores for each model are as follows: on GSM-8K, the Llama-3-8B-it model scores 79% and “Ours” scores 80%; on MMLU, Llama-3-8B-it scores 66% and “Ours” scores 65%; on HumanEval, Llama-3-8B-it scores 61% and “Ours” scores 63%; on TruthfulQA, Llama-3-8B-it scores 44% and “Ours” scores 60%; on ARC, Llama-3-8B-it scores 60% and “Ours” scores 64%; on MBPP, Llama-3-8B-it scores 61% and “Ours” scores 61%; on LC AlpacaEval-2, Llama-3-8B-it scores 23% and “Ours” scores 31%; on MT-Bench (×5), Llama-3-8B-it scores 41% and “Ours” scores 42%; and on Chat-Arena-Hard, Llama-3-8B-it scores 21% and “Ours” scores 30%. The bars are not sorted by value, and no visual emphasis is applied to any particular bar beyond their color coding and height.
